welcome:
Welcome! 🚗

I'll help you appeal a traffic fine in Israel.

Send me a photo or PDF of your fine notice and I will:
• Recognise the text (OCR)
• Extract the key details
• Generate a formal appeal letter in Hebrew

Maximum file size: 15 MB
